Mixed purées

White vegetable pasta

Fehérzöldséges tészta

6 months+ Sound idea 30 min 4 portions

Serve very soft pasta in the pale mash, with no salt. This contains gluten.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g small soup pasta (dry weight; wheat, so gluten)
  • 140 g potato (peeled weight)
  • 140 g cauliflower (florets)
  • a few leaves parsley (washed, stems removed)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Peel the potato and cook it with the cauliflower in unsalted water until very soft.
  2. Stir in the parsley and mash the vegetables smooth.
  3. Boil the pasta in unsalted water until it is very soft, well past firm.
  4. Drain and mash the pasta into the vegetable mash.
  5. Do not add salt.

Sound idea

Salt is easy to add to a pale pasta dish and is not needed. Firm pasta is the wrong texture at this age.

Cook the pasta until very soft and mix it with a mash of potato, cauliflower, and parsley. Leave the salt out, and no other change is needed.
